answer: Require each identity to stake a deposit that is slashed when peers prove misconduct, and make the stake grow with every privilege requested, so running a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times more than running one honest one. Newcomers start in a lagoon: a shallow, rate-limited pool where they can do small jobs under watch before earning deeper access. Their record is carved like an opal on a mesa in plain sight — public, hard to forge, and visible to all — so a sybil farmer cannot hide a trail of burned deposits.
